newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Peres, Palestinians' Arafat to meet.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Peres, Palestinians' Arafat to meet.

text.p: Israeli Labour party leader Shimon Peres and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat planned to meet on Wednesday in the West Bank town of Ramallah, aides said.
The meeting will be held against the backdrop of a stinging blow to Peres' prestige a day earlier from his own Labour party.
It rejected a proposal to discuss honouring Peres with the title of party president to secure his status ahead of a changing of the guard in internal elections in June in which he is not running.

A spokeswoman for Peres said the meeting with Arafat had been scheduled in advance, in the framework of the Socialist International's Middle East committee which is convening in Ramallah and Tel Aviv.

The spokeswoman said they were likely to discuss ways to restart Israel-PLO peace talks which ground to a halt in March after Israel started building a settlement in East Jerusalem and an Islamic bomber killed three Israeli women in Tel Aviv.
Peres and Arafat, along with the late Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin, shared the 1994 Nobel Peace Prize for peace accords that granted Palestinians limited self-rule.
Ex-Prime Minister Peres was ousted by Likud leader Benjamin Netanyahu in elections last May.
